original.inspection: Complete prose read using a local OCR aid; critical formulas inspected in the scan. The separately referenced plate is not reproduced; our curve drawing is editorial.

englishComparison.use: Linked for comparison; not reproduced. Translator footnotes are not imported as Euler's text.

rendering.basis: Independent modern-English rendering from the original French
rendering.scope: Whole paper: opening, both positions, seven arguments, nine objections, replies, resolution, theorem and its proof, four problems, all ten examples and all value progressions, roots-of-unity discussion, final calculation and closing.
rendering.method: Modern rendering rather than diplomatic transcription. Repeated formulations and lists are consolidated with their mathematical content retained. Editorial passage labels subdivide originally unnumbered prose.

printingRepairs.repair: x=0 replaces printed x=1 in the inference log(1)=0 from the logarithm series

rendering.proofStatus: Five written reconstructions; no proof-assistant verification. Historical false or unqualified inferences are retained and qualified in commentary.
rendering.comparisonTypo: The original French p. 163 has sqrt(-1); the English comparison file prints sqrt(-a) in two corresponding negative-logarithm formulas. Our text follows the French.

bibliography.writtenDate: Archive metadata records 1747; publication year determines URL
bibliography.citationEvidence: Euler's original p. 141 explicitly names Letters CXC and CXCIII in the correspondence. ETH identifies its 1745 two-volume publication.
